description:
`/work/jobs.json` is a JSON array of jobs. Each job is an object `{"name": NAME, "argv": [PROGRAM, ARG, ...], "cwd": DIR, "env": {VAR: VALUE, ...}}`, where `DIR` is relative to `/work`.

Run the jobs one after another, in order. Start each job's program directly with exactly its `argv` items as arguments, never through a shell, so every item reaches the program unchanged, empty ones included. Run it in its `cwd`, with its `env` added to the environment your program inherited. Capture its standard output and standard error separately, as text.

Write `/work/results.json`, a JSON array with one object per job in order: `{"name": NAME, "exit": STATUS, "stdout": OUT, "stderr": ERR}`, where `STATUS` is the exit status. A job whose program cannot be started at all gets `"exit": null` with empty `stdout` and `stderr`, and the remaining jobs still run. Exit with status 0 when every job exited with status 0, and with status 4 otherwise.
